en.coach.rule.focus_emergency.title: Your focus lock this week
en.coach.rule.focus_emergency.body: Emergency unlock was used {{done}} times this week. That is simply a count, and some days need it. If the salah windows or the unlock mode don't fit your routine, you're welcome to adjust them.
en.fiqh.diff.umrah.taqsir.title: How much a man shortens (taqsir)
en.fiqh.diff.umrah.taqsir.hanafi: At least a quarter of the head must be shaved or shortened.
en.fiqh.diff.umrah.taqsir.shafii: At least three hairs of the head, shaved or shortened, are enough.
en.fiqh.diff.umrah.taqsir.wholeHead: The whole head: shortening only part of it is not enough.
